what: The everyday user home on the Today page, driven in headless Chrome on 2026-10-05: a city on the worldwide 3D map, a route on the city's own network, the departure slider, 'Leave when?', the simulated view, the alerts strip.
headline: No city has traffic data yet, so no route is coloured and no travel time in traffic is given anywhere. Every route in this record is the grey dashed 'no traffic data' line. The colour, forecast and travel-time paths are exercised only by unit tests with test rows that never reach the app.
command: cd frontend && npm run build; python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8011; a DevTools script opened /, clicked the map twice, moved the slider, set an arrival time, switched the simulated view on and off, zoomed out and clicked a far point

bangla.still_english: the tag's source and basis sentences, the units (min, km, cells) and the network's description come from the backend in English

real_sources_today.phones: 3 cells and 10 positions are stored in results/live/lifeos.sqlite, all sent with the city name 'Gazipur' and none inside any built city's box; the home counts cells by position, so every city shows 0

pems.state: pending: account not approved; logged-in terms and data freshness not read; nothing fetched

forecast_model: Chronos-2 through the existing adapter. On this laptop `import chronos` fails (a broken TensorFlow install, the same cause as six long-failing adapter tests), so a real forecast could not be run here even with data; the page would say 'the forecast model cannot run on this machine'.
not_checked: a route coloured by real speed, a forecast, a travel time in traffic or a 'Leave by' answer in the browser: no city has the data; only unit tests cover them
a real Chronos-2 forecast on section series (the model cannot be imported on this machine)
place search by typing a name, and 'Use my location' (headless Chrome has no location); the route was set by map clicks only
changing city with the switcher while a route is shown (each city was opened by reloading the page)
the alerts strip with an alert in it (the stored alerts table is empty; the feed is unit-tested)
a phone or touch screen, and a real graphics card
whether the fastest path at speed limits is a route a person would take; one-way streets and turn bans are only as good as OpenStreetMap and netconvert made them
the simulated view on the home was watched for about 15 seconds per city
